description: This file is a C# source code file for an ASP.NET Core application that integrates Orleans grains and configures web server endpoints for managing and interacting with Orleans grains, including grain reset and forest addition functionalities.

classes.name: LoaderGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementation managing forests and reset operations, maintaining internal counters and interacting with other grains.

classes.name: FanOutGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing a fan-out pattern with hierarchical child grains, capable of pinging its children.

classes.name: HardLimitRule
classes.description: A class implementing IImbalanceToleranceRule, defining a threshold for imbalance tolerance.

methods.name: AddForest
methods.description: Adds a new forest by creating a new FanOutGrain and pinging it.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the grain's internal counters and triggers resets on related grains and services.

methods.name: GetResetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the grain has been reset.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Recursively pings child grains to check their responsiveness.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the imbalance is within the tolerated limit.
